title: Periods
note: In Mathematics Unlimited — 2001 and Beyond, Springer, Berlin, Heidelberg (2001), 771-808. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-56478-9_39) (2026-11-28). Defines the ring of effective periods, states Conjecture 1 (all algebraic relations among periods come from linearity, change of variables, and Stokes/Newton-Leibniz), and records that transcendence of weight-2 dilogarithm / hyperbolic 3-manifold volume periods remains open.
